resolved_conflicts.explanation: The July 1941 item reports the tower as ordered; NHLR and the 2024 blog give 1941 as the build year. Read together, these fit a 1941 order and construction.

notes_for_editor: Build year 1941 agrees across three sources. Access (key from the caretaker) rests on a single 2024 blog post; no official access rules were found, and the Illinois DNR page I tried returned an unrelated park, so it is not cited. Surviving-tower counts differ: NHLR says two state towers remain, the 2024 blog says three in Illinois. The blog's count of about 30 Illinois towers differs from NHLR's 10 state plus 7 federal; not used. No staffing or fire records found. Fact-check 2026-10-08: a reader comment on the 2024 blog (dated June 7, 2026) lists a park phone number; it is unverified and not used. The story no longer says the sources give no phone number. The blog's two missing windows are a visit-time observation; the caretaker's replacements are a separate general remark.
